title: WPSS/2755/2017 of Trilochan Joshi Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WSS No. 2755 of 2017
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. C.S. Joshi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Vikas Pande, Standing
Counsel alongwith Mr. R.C. Joshi,
Brief Holder for the
State/respondents.
Heard.
By means of this petition,
petitioner seeks following relief:
ì(i) issue a writ, order or direction
in the nature of mandamus commanding
and directing the respondents to
allot/transfer the district to the petitioner
as per the first option filed in the form on
the basis of the condition contained in
the rules as well as in the advertisement.
(ii) issue a writ, order or direction
in the nature of commanding and
directing the respondents to allot the
District Udham Singh Nagar to the
petitioner as per first option by the
petitioner as seats are still vacant.
Petitioner was appointed as
Primary School Teacher in District
Almora, pursuant to a selection held
in the year 2014. Now, he is seeking
transfer to District Udham Singh
Nagar, on the ground that Udham
Singh Nagar was District of his first
choice and as per his ranking in the
select list, he was entitled for
allotment to District Udham Singh
Nagar.
Learned counsel for the
petitioner confines his prayer and
submits that petitioner may be

permitted to make representation and
Competent Authority be directed to
consider petitionerís representation
within some specific time frame.
Without expressing any opinion
on the merits of the claim of the
petitioner, I dispose of the writ
petition with liberty to the petitioner
to make a representation to the
Additional Director (Elementary
Education), Kumaon Mandal within
three weeks from today. If such,
representation is made, Additional
Director (Elementary Education),
Kumaon Mandal shall consider and
decide the same by passing a
reasoned and speaking order within
ten weeks thereafter.
Pending application, if any,
stands disposed of accordingly
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
 22.09.2017
Mamta
